comparison.objective: Shelve three books upright and brace the row with a bookend.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated upright insertion, gap control, and terminal bracing.
comparison.success_condition: Books form a closed upright row with gaps at most 5 mm and tilt at most 5 degrees; flat or stacked books zero the trial.
comparison.reason: Shelving and bracing do not test coupled screw-and-locknut manipulation.
